vendors.description: Free food at Eddy House Drop-In Center (Eddy House). Schedule: Mon–Sun 8:30 AM–9:30 AM (Breakfast); Mon–Sun 12 PM–1 PM (Lunch); Mon–Sun 5 PM–6 PM (Dinner). Eligibility: Youth ages 18-24 experiencing homelessness; free breakfast, lunch, and dinner at drop-in center.. Call 775-384-1129 to confirm before you go — hours change and supplies can run out. Source: community research, Oct 2026.
